title: Welcome to ConfigForge
intro: ConfigForge works in two modes. Pick whichever fits how you'll use it. You can switch later from Settings.

author.title: Author baselines anywhere
author.body: Edit, diff, compare, and export OSConfig baselines on any OS. No extra installs needed.

deploy.title: Author + deploy on this machine
deploy.body: Windows or Linux. Needs OSConfig installed locally to apply or audit baselines against this device.
